data.content_ref: inline:The target proposes a 'reduction' relation but fails to define the specific mechanism of reduction or explain how scientific prediction maps onto biological fitness. Instead, it immediately jumps to the 'refuted if' condition without establishing the substantive connection required by the problem context. A summary of the analogy is not a relation; the target omits the 'what it is' part of the proposed relation, rendering the subsequent refutation condition ungrounded.
